baseline.provenance_boundary: User-designated official pinned archive/binary. Asset SHA256 and extraction-byte fidelity checks belong to the parent; this inventory fingerprints the actual read-only tree and checks binary version metadata. No Git or old local vstd is consulted.

scope.target: Exactly source_api.json.apis, in the same order; no source inventory reconstruction.

classes.exact: Exact executable signature/type/lifetime domain, via an assumed spec or generic method + concrete spec impl. Weak/conditional/opaque clauses are preserved; this is NOT semantic completeness.
classes.partial: Only a proper type domain or call form has a concrete contract; generic framework clauses may remain for the rest.
classes.trait_only: The exact trait method has a generic declaration/guarded contract, but no matching concrete owner/trait-argument model. No-ensures declarations are included and identified.
classes.indirect: No target method contract; only another collection/iterator/borrow/delegation identity has a relevant contract. Not API coverage.
classes.none: No target method contract or resolved covered collection/delegation edge. Views/type registration/primitive arithmetic are not method coverage.

scope.signature_domain: Rust executable generics, allocators, lifetimes and receiver/trait arguments retained; const execution and panic-domain completeness are not claimed. Value preconditions remain literal.
scope.dependencies: Collection/view/constructor/delegation relations, not a whole-program call graph or primitive-operation survey. Original direct_calls remain referenced in source_api.json.
scope.trust: Existing assumptions, external bodies and axioms are evidence of vstd coverage, never source implementation correctness or spec-determin-tool completeness.

candidate_dispositions.std_specs/vec.rs: Every assume is bound once: stable target or explicit unstable exclusion; also contains compiler hooks and concrete trait models.
candidate_dispositions.view.rs: Vec/DeepView/Box/ref view definitions, not executable Vec API bindings.
candidate_dispositions.std_specs/iter.rs: Generic and blanket iterator frameworks; no extra source targets.
candidate_dispositions.std_specs/slice.rs: Only slice/iterator/index/comparison dependencies, never reclassified as Vec identities.
candidate_dispositions.slice.rs: Slice views/indexing and Copy-only vstd wrapper, not Vec conversion specs.
candidate_dispositions.std_specs/smart_ptrs.rs: Allocator-generic slice into_vec has Box receiver, not Vec::From<Box>.
candidate_dispositions.std_specs/alloc.rs: Compiler vec-literal helpers outside source-owned scope.

candidate_dispositions.string.rs: String/str declarations and custom byte Vec wrapper, only str::as_bytes relevant as a dependency.
candidate_dispositions.contrib/exec_spec/seq.rs: Custom execution traits/wrappers using Vec, not std Vec API specifications.

views.domain: Vec<T, A>, T unrestricted, A: Allocator
views.meaning: View::V = Seq<T>; DeepView maps each element and separately requires T: DeepView. Ghost/allocator cfg has A; the non-ghost fallback is Global-only. The index-decreases, has_resolved and decreases-to-view axioms here explicitly use default-allocator Vec<T>, unlike the allocator-generic len axiom.
views.source_bridge_required: Relate the initialized prefix of buf/len to Seq, including ZST and length bounds. The opaque view does not expose capacity, allocation, addresses or allocator identity.

views.meaning: The Vec borrow constructors tie slice@ to the Vec sequence; mutable constructors give immediate equality and final(slice)@ == final(vec)@.
views.source_bridge_required: Preserve lawful writes and the initialized-region relation. Pointer metadata alone is not content; final is the borrow's final value, not evidence of Drop execution.

views.domain: I: SliceIndex<[T]>; mutable Vec content hook only for usize indexing syntax
views.meaning: Vec index_req quantifies over slices with the same sequence; immutable index has an existential slice/call_ensures postcondition. usize plus six range SliceIndex models are explicit in std_specs/slice.rs.
views.source_bridge_required: Do not transfer the slice IndexMut postcondition through Vec's generic IndexMut without a source/delegation proof. The generic IndexMut trait only adds a precondition.

views.domain: Iterator / DoubleEndedIterator / ExactSizeIterator; no concrete representation implied
views.meaning: remaining is the prophetic sequence of future yielded items. Transition laws are guarded by obeys_prophetic_iter_laws; will_return_none and an optional decrease metric are separate observations.
views.source_bridge_required: Establish the concrete iterator's law predicate and its constructor/state relation. An arbitrary guarded framework is not a view of a source representation.

views.domain: IntoIter<T, A>, T unrestricted, A: Allocator
views.meaning: remaining is prophetic; into_iter_elts(i) is an uninterpreted, non-prophetic observation of the iterator value/state i. peek/peek_back use that observation. obeys_prophetic_iter_laws is true for IntoIter; will_return_none and decrease remain uninterpreted.
views.source_bridge_required: Vec::into_iter establishes remaining(i0) == vec@ == into_iter_elts(i0) and decrease(i0) is Some. next/next_back change remaining, but give no equation for into_iter_elts(i1). Neither frozen-original contents nor elts(i1)==remaining(i1) is an invariant supplied by vstd. as_slice/as_mut_slice/Clone/Default need their own state connections.

views.meaning: Iter remaining is Seq<&T>; constructor elts == remaining.unref(). IterMut remaining is Seq<&mut T>; slice::iter_mut relates each reference's initial/final value to the corresponding slice slot.
views.source_bridge_required: The shared Vec IntoIterator impl is directly assumed. &mut Vec IntoIterator is not: its source delegates through DerefMut to slice::iter_mut. Do not confuse that with the deref-visible method vec.iter_mut(), which is not a Vec-owned target.

views.domain: FromIterator<T> for Vec<T> (Global, exactly as in the source); input I: IntoIterator<Item=T>
views.meaning: from_iter ensures result@ == into_iter_remaining(input). The supplied axiom relates this UF to remaining only for inputs that are themselves Iterator + IteratorSpec; it is not in group_iter_axioms.
views.source_bridge_required: For arbitrary IntoIterator inputs, do not silently replace into_iter_remaining(input) by remaining(input.into_iter()) or Vec input contents. collect's conditional trait contract is a separate route. No allocator-general FromIterator impl is present in the source target.

views.meaning: cloned(a,b) = call_ensures(T::clone, (&a,), b) || a == b. Generic Clone::clone has no postcondition; element equality and Clone/callback side-effect traces are not supplied.
views.source_bridge_required: Preserve the reflexive weak relation and allocator.clone requirements; do not upgrade it to element equality or erase stateful Clone behavior.

views.domain: T: PartialEq<U>; Vec operands may have distinct A1/A2
views.meaning: Vec-to-Vec eq/ne use T::obeys_eq_spec and pointwise T::eq_spec. The explicit eq assume has no own ensures. Other Vec/Cow/slice/array pairings have only their generic trait contract, not this concrete model. The three law/view-equality proof helpers are Global-only and do not strengthen the A1/A2-generic method contracts.
views.source_bridge_required: Do not infer structural equality unconditionally, collapse allocators, or apply ne.default_ensures to the source's explicit ne implementations. Vec Ord/PartialOrd have no concrete comparison model here.

views.domain: Cow<'a,[T]> View requires T: View + Clone; DeepView requires T: DeepView + Clone
views.meaning: Both Borrowed and Owned branches map to the contained sequence; the sequence view alone forgets the variant. The enum type registration is not an API conversion specification.
views.source_bridge_required: Source Cow conversions require Clone / ToOwned, not T: View or DeepView. Preserve the full source type domain and variant/borrowing relation; do not add those extra bounds merely to use the official view.

views.meaning: Box into_vec has an A: Allocator signature; the literal View-for-Box impl in view.rs is default-allocator only, with borrowed/deref observations also available. str::as_bytes returns UTF-8 bytes, not char count.
views.source_bridge_required: These are different identities from Vec/Cow/Box From and array TryFrom. slice_to_vec<T:Copy> is a vstd wrapper, not a spec for source Clone-generic From<&[T]> or slice::to_vec.

views.domain: Drain<'a,T,A> with source lifetime and allocator domain intact
views.meaning: No active Drain name, external type, constructor spec or concrete iterator-law specialization in this official vstd.
views.source_bridge_required: Connect Vec::drain to head/remaining/tail and moved-out T values; track tail restoration by real Drop separately from borrow final. forget may skip cleanup. Generic guarded Iterator laws do not establish this connection.

views.meaning: No active ExtractIf name, type/constructor spec or concrete iterator model.
views.source_bridge_required: Connect vec/idx/end/del/old_len/pred to retained, removed, unvisited and out-of-range regions; preserve mutable element/predicate state, order, panic and lazy Drop behavior.

views.meaning: No active Splice name, type/constructor spec or concrete iterator model. ExactSizeIterator::len remains an inherited generic contract, not a new source-owned API.
views.source_bridge_required: Relate Drain regions and replace_with state at construction; replacement is consumed during Drop, including fill/move-tail/temporary-Vec paths. final does not prove Drop; forgotten Splice has weaker removal semantics.

views.domain: allocator, RawVec, initialized/spare regions, raw pointers, callbacks and destructors
views.meaning: Type-level trait registration and Seq abstractions are not capacity/layout/ownership/lifecycle or callback-state specifications.
views.source_bridge_required: Retain private source specialization/guards as proof dependencies. No API acceptance, new view axiom, synthetic lifecycle machine or source rewrite is performed by this inventory.
